test.create_query: CREATE TABLE iws_part (l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String) ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = 'iceberg_write_scale_part_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/') PARTITION BY toMonthNumSinceEpoch(l_shipdate)
CREATE TABLE iws_files AS iws_part ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = 'iceberg_write_scale_files_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/')
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO iws_part SELECT * FROM tpch10.lineitem SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 4, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 1000000

INSERT INTO iws_files SELECT * FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 10 = 0 SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 4, max_block_size = 10000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 10000

SELECT throwIf(sum(record_count) != (SELECT count() FROM tpch10.lineitem) OR uniqExact(partition) != 84 OR count() > 4 * 84) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'iws_part'

SELECT throwIf(sum(record_count) != (SELECT count() FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 10 = 0) OR max(record_count) >= 20000 OR countIf(record_count < 10000) > 4) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'iws_files'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(*)) FROM iws_part) != (count(), sum(cityHash64(* REPLACE (toFloat64(l_quantity) AS l_quantity, toFloat64(l_extendedprice) AS l_extendedprice, toFloat64(l_discount) AS l_discount, toFloat64(l_tax) AS l_tax))))) FROM tpch10.lineitem

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(*)) FROM iws_files) != (count(), sum(cityHash64(* REPLACE (toFloat64(l_quantity) AS l_quantity, toFloat64(l_extendedprice) AS l_extendedprice, toFloat64(l_discount) AS l_discount, toFloat64(l_tax) AS l_tax))))) FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 10 = 0
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS iws_part, iws_files, iws_part_run, iws_files_run SYNC
